providers.title: The index-form criterion
providers.scope: On a complete Riemannian manifold, if the index form of every compactly supported field along every complete unit-speed geodesic is nonnegative, there are no conjugate points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Assembly over visits
providers.scope: If the sectional curvature is nonpositive outside an open set U and the index form of every compactly supported field is nonnegative on every visit of every geodesic to U, the metric has no conjugate points.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A three-manifold without conjugate points and without nonpositive curvature
providers.scope: There is a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold with a metric without conjugate points that admits no metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Normal forms in amalgamated products
providers.scope: Every element of G_1 *_A G_2 is uniquely a s_1 ... s_n with a in A and alternating coset representatives; the factors embed and reduced alternating products are not in A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The fundamental group of the two-piece graph manifold
providers.scope: pi_1(M) is an amalgam over Z^2 in which f_2 = h_1, h_2 = h_1 f_1, each h_i is a commutator in the centralizer of f_i, and h_1, f_1 generate Z^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hadamard manifolds satisfy the CN inequality
providers.scope: A Hadamard manifold is a proper geodesic space with unique geodesic segments satisfying d(x,c_t)^2 <= (1-t)d(x,y)^2 + t d(x,z)^2 - t(1-t)d(y,z)^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nearest-point projections in CN spaces
providers.scope: Projections onto complete convex subsets exist, are unique, satisfy the obtuse-angle inequality, do not increase distances and commute with isometries preserving the set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Pythagorean identity for parallel lines
providers.scope: Parallel geodesic lines in a CN space satisfy d(c(s),c'(u))^2 = D^2 + (s - u + sigma)^2 for constants D and sigma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Shifts between parallel lines add
providers.scope: For pairwise parallel lines, sigma(c_1,c_3) = sigma(c_1,c_2) + sigma(c_2,c_3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Axes of hyperbolic isometries
providers.scope: Every point of the minimal set of a hyperbolic isometry of a CN space lies on an axis, and l(g^n) = |n| l(g).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The length formula
providers.scope: If h commutes with a hyperbolic g, is semisimple and has shift zero, then l(g^m h^n)^2 = m^2 l(g)^2 + n^2 l(h)^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Semisimplicity under proper cocompact actions
providers.scope: In a proper cocompact action on a proper CN space every element is semisimple and every element of infinite order is hyperbolic.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The two-piece obstruction
providers.scope: The fundamental group of the two-piece graph manifold has no proper cocompact isometric action on a proper CAT(0) space.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No metric of nonpositive curvature
providers.scope: The two-piece graph manifold admits no Riemannian metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A concave cometric
providers.scope: For small delta the matrix path P is bounded, concave, and satisfies |P'p|^2 <= C delta p^T(-P'')p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The metric on the graph manifold
providers.scope: The neck metric dt^2 + dx^T P^-1 dx, convex warped collars and flat cores form a smooth metric with nonpositive curvature outside the open neck.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Endpoint correction
providers.scope: The intrinsic index form equals the coordinate energy minus the endpoint term <T, Gamma(V,V)>, which is nonnegative at entries and exits when the field is tangent to the boundary.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Passage classification
providers.scope: A visit of a geodesic to the neck is the whole line at constant height, a monotone passage, or a returning passage with one turn.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The returning estimate
providers.scope: For small delta every returning passage has nonnegative normal index form, uniformly in all its parameters.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The main theorem
providers.scope: The constructed metric on the two-piece graph manifold has no conjugate points, and the manifold admits no metric of nonpositive curvature.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
